text.description_html:
Weslock Oval Deadbolt

This deadbolt is from the Weslock Elegance Collection and features a classic oval rose. It has a five pin lock cylinder and a heavy duty security strike with 3 inch screws. It is available as a Single Cylinder (key operated from the outside, thumb turn operated from the inside) or a Double Cylinder (key operated from both outside and inside). It is available in your choice of oil rubbed bronze or satin nickel finish.

  • Finish: Oil Rubbed Bronze
    • Features of the Elegance Collection Oval Deadbolt:
    • Heavy duty security strike with 3" long screws.
    • 5 pin lock cylinder.
    • 1" throw deadbolt with two hardened steel rollers.
    • Limited Lifetime Mechanical Warranty
    • Limited Lifetime Year Finish Warranty

    Specifications of the Weslock Elegance Collection Oval Deadbolt:

    • Height: 3-7/8"
    • Width: 2-1/2"
    • Interior Single Cylinder Projection: 1-3/4"
    • Interior Double Cylinder Projection: 7/8"
    • Exterior Single Cylinder and Double Cylinder Projection: 7/8"
    • Fits doors prepared with 2-1/8" or 1-5/8" cross bore hole and 1" edge hole
    • Door Thickness: adjustable from1-3/8" to 2".
    • Backset: adjustable latches for either 2-3/8" or 2-3/4" with removable faceplate.

    When Selecting a Function:

    • Single Cylinder: The deadbolt is thrown and retracted by a key from the exterior and by a thumb turn from the interior.



    ** Item Discontinued, see available Locks
